findings: reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:898 non-blocking: _wait_probe_job_ids reads any comma-separated numeric operand as a scheduler job batch whatever the command is, so a probe such as `nc -z host 80,443` now names jobs 80 and 443; squeue then fails on ids that were never jobs, _scheduler_job_alive returns None, and that run can never read as producer-gone. The direction is fail-safe (no false abandonment) but the previous reading of such a probe as naming no job is lost.
